# GrowthRates (growth-rates-lean)

Fekete-type growth rates, uniform envelopes and finite-time errors, in Lean 4 with Mathlib.
Lean v4.35.0, Mathlib v4.35.0 (commit 56a005855ea17e0b0958f73ec801ae140b0a1679). Namespace GrowthRates. Apache-2.0. Author Le Chen.
Repository: https://github.com/chenle02/growth-rates-lean
No release yet; the version, tag and DOI are set at the first release.

The Lean declaration decides every hypothesis. Prose is not checked by Lean.
A receipt under .lean-receipts/ covers only the commit it names.

Main declarations (all limits as t → ∞; the RealFekete, LogDefect and Envelope results conclude their limits and values; the FiniteError results assume the rate lam and conclude explicit finite-time bounds; everything else is a hypothesis):
- GrowthRates.RealFekete.tendsto_div_rate: RealTimeBounds b (b ≥ 0 and b(t+u) ≤ b t + b u on [0, ∞), b bounded above on every [0, h]) gives b t / t → rate b = sInf {b h / h : h > 0}. Also rate_le_slope, rate_nonneg.
- GrowthRates.RealFekete.tendsto_div_rate_of_comparison, lower_bound_of_comparison: m ≤ b ≤ m + A + B log(1+t) on t > 0 gives m t / t → rate b; the upper comparison gives t rate b - A - B log(1+t) ≤ m t for t > 0.
- GrowthRates.RealFekete.log_rate_of_submul: SubmulInputs N C and 0 < F ≤ N, log N ≤ log F + A + B log(1+t) give log F t / t → rate (log ∘ N) and the finite-time lower bound.
- GrowthRates.LogDefect.tendsto_div_rate: M, B ≥ 0, h ≥ 1, a monotone and a x ≤ C x on [h, ∞), a x + a y - M log(x+y) - B ≤ a(x+y) for x, y ≥ h give a t / t → sup_{x ≥ h} (a x - M log x - B - M log(9/2)) / x. Also balanced_merge, corrected_nat_blocks, nat_blocks.
- GrowthRates.LogDefect.tendsto_div_delayedRate, tendsto_log_div_delayedRate: delayed form b S + b T - M log(2+S+T) - B ≤ b(S+T+1) for S, T ≥ T0, and its multiplicative version for f ≥ 1; limit delayedRate ≥ 0.
- GrowthRates.Envelope.envelope_limit, real_order_lower, control_sandwich, control_limit, joint_limit, corrected_sInf, glb_div_time: from fixed even-order limits q(2k+2, T) → a k and one lower error e T → 0 uniform in k, the infimum over orders tends to C = glb a k; with q antitone in the order p ≥ 2, q(p j, T j) → C whenever p j, T j → ∞.
- GrowthRates.FiniteError.finite_bounds, optimize, log_error: f ≥ 1, log f t / t → lam (hypothesis), cut, confinement and composition inequalities, f 0 = 1, n > 0 give |log f T - T lam| ≤ n (1 + log(2 + T lam / n)) for T ≥ 0.
- GrowthRates.FiniteError.sandwich_error, joint_error: two orders with CutInputs give |x / (p z) - C| ≤ cn - C + (1 + log(2 + M z)) / z for x sandwiched between them.

Not proved:
- Local boundedness and nonnegativity are hypotheses; no measurability-only continuous-time Fekete lemma.
- No general de Bruijn–Erdős theorem.
- No convergence rates in the Fekete lemmas.
- All comparison, cut, confinement and composition inequalities (and the envelope inputs) are hypotheses; none is derived for a concrete model.
- No probability and no PDE content.

Build: lake exe cache get && lake build. Keep lean-toolchain and lake-manifest.json unchanged; never run lake update in a verification run.
Receipt build check: bash verify.sh LOG (run by lean-pkg from a clean checkout). Negative controls: bash scripts/check-negative-controls.sh (after lake build GrowthRates).
Permitted axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. GrowthRates/Challenge.lean has sorry by design.
